decision: No-Go for frozen current compact representation

input_audit.object_carriers: 256 learned VLM queries, distinct from detection object queries; no guaranteed object-to-token mapping
input_audit.ego_carrier: one can_bus embedding appended by detection head
input_audit.map_carriers: 256 learned VLM queries, distinct from decoded lane queries
input_audit.insertion: IMAGE_TOKEN_INDEX=-200 at original prompt image placeholder
input_audit.effective_tokens: Original text length minus one sentinel plus 513; compact uses native text positions, compact+full expands the retained sentinel
input_audit.attention: Native causal attention/position generation; tokenizer and weights unchanged
input_audit.map_fields: Decoded lane control points and scores, not complete topology, markings, sign or traffic light state
input_audit.current_compact: Lossy fixed class/xy/lane-first-mid-last/ego format; new format comprehension not assumed

oracle_probe.reason: No GT capability probe needed to decide measured online-input candidate; GT excluded from runtime and formal quality decisions
